data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 5
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
¡Dale!  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
Nice to meet you… Encantado  
Good day… Buenos días  
One more time… Otra vez  
We're making friends today.  

[Verse]  
Walking up to the front door,  
knocking like I never have before.  
Oye… Hey you, over there,  
Mira… Look, a smile to share.  
Listen… Escucha, come and say hi,  
Neighbors passing by.  
Tell me… Cuéntame, how's your day?  
Wait… Espera, I’ll find a way.  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
Nice to meet you… Encantado  
Good day… Buenos días  
One more time… Otra vez  
We're making friends today.  

[Verse]  
Of course… Claro, I’ll lend a hand,  
Vale… Okay, let’s make a plan.  
Pues… Well, it's nice to see,  
De nada… You're welcome, truly.  
Come over, bring your family too,  
We'll chat like old friends do.  

[Bridge]  
The sun is shining, skies are blue,  
Time to make dreams come true.  
With every word, we're breaking through,  
Building bonds between me and you.  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
Nice to meet you… Encantado
